summary: Promoted J-17: the desk top-up asks the vendor only for bars the frozen store cannot already prove (measured: the one recorded real run topup-2026-07-29-5de907c83fc4 = 0 reused / 390 fetched / 14 failed; for the 235 already-held pairs it downloaded 276,714 bars to gain 13,533, and for 174 of them <=5 new bars each) - this closes the ONE uncovered vision claim, Key Capability 2 / Vision para 2's 'store-first (a symbol x timeframe already frozen in the store is reused, never re-fetched)', which is structurally unreachable today because the fetch window is wall-clock while store-first is an exact-key window hit; every other Vision and Key-Capability claim is covered by an existing journey, except the coverage view's own page (GET /research/desk/coverage has no /desk surface), already backlogged as desk-live-coverage-view-on-page.
